title: 5/5 Good quality great packaging
text: 5/5 Good quality great packaging. Perfect and they actually fit really well I bought two different brands because I wasn't sure which one to buy and decided I would still use them on my other drawers. In the end when they both arrived I noticed a big difference in the packaging and this one honestly looked way better. When I opened them both this one just looks better in general and works great for my gray drawers as well because of the colour. It was a little smaller than the other brand I bought but I noticed right away that it was harder to bend so better material overall and quality as well as packaging. Arrived really fast so 5/5 stars :)
